hi all! heres a new fence replacement that turns your fences into a pretty lattice fence

[b][u]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/u][/b]

-unzip the downloaded .rar file
-navigate to your Content\LooseSprites folder
-place the Fence5.xnb file there overwriting the original Fence5.xnb file


[b][u]NOTES:
[/u][/b]
-this replaces the HARDWOOD FENCE
- if you want it to replace a different fence, rename the file to
Fence1.xnb for normal wood fence
Fence2.xnb for stone fence
Fence3.xnb for iron fence
